subject: LumenMade vendor onboarding: invoice field dictionary + channel preference
messages:
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@lumenmade.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding + invoice submission approach

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for starting the onboarding thread. We're ramping toward our first POs for Q4 and want to make sure our billing flow matches Redwood's expectations. Quick list of asks from our finance team: 

- Which invoice intake channel should we prioritize (portal vs email)? any differences in SLA/ack behavior?
- Do you require a PO-stamp on the PDF/CSV, or can we include PO numbers as a column?
- Can you confirm a minimal CSV header we should produce (so our ERP export is aligned)?
- Any subject/tagging requirement for email fallback (e.g., subject token)?

We're attaching an example invoice PDF and can export a CSV once we have the header spec. We prefer portal but can do email if it's simpler to start.

Attached: LM_sample_invoice.pdf (stub)

Appreciate a short checklist we can follow so our operations team can ship this without back-and-forth.

Best,
Sarah Cho
Finance Operations
LumenMade

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@lumenmade.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding + invoice submission approach

Hi Sarah — great to meet you virtually. Welcome aboard! Short answers up front, followed by a small "what we need from you" checklist.

Summary: Portal preferred for production (idempotency, auto-ack, structured metadata). Email is supported as a fallback with a subject token and minimal header requirements. Both are documented; see the onboarding form link below.

Why portal?
- Automatic idempotency / duplicate detection
- Faster ack / reconciliation hooks (webhook ack)
- Easier line-item parsing and error feedback

Email fallback rules (if you choose email initially):
- Send to: vendor@redwood-billing.com
- Subject must include: "VendorToken: LM-4521" (we'll provide a token when you finish the onboarding form)
- Preferred attachment: CSV (UTF-8), or PDF with a machine-readable table
- We'll accept PDFs but parsing errors require manual review (slower SLA)

Minimal CSV header we recommend (exact column names, order encouraged):
InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PO_Number, VendorName, LineDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, LineTotal, Currency, TaxAmount, TotalAmount, BillingAddress, RemitToAccount, ContactEmail

PO stamping: We do not require a visual PO stamp on the PDF if the PO_Number column is present and matches the PO in our system. For email fallback, please ensure PO_Number is embedded in the subject or first row for reliability.

What we need from you (short MA P):
- Complete onboarding form (one-time): https://redwood.app/onboarding/form/LM-4521
- Attach the sample CSV (using the header above) to the form or email it to vendor@redwood-billing.com with Subject: "VendorToken: pending"
- Confirm if your ERP can emit UTF-8 CSV; if not, tell us encoding/export options

I've attached our single-page onboarding form and a compact sample CSV header file for your team to copy. Once you submit the form we'll provision the subject token and turn on portal access.

Thanks — looping in Kimberly from procurement for PO-stamping policy confirmation.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: lumenmade_invoice_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding + invoice submission approach

Markus / Kim — forwarding Sarah's note and my reply. Two quick internal questions: 

1) For LM-4521, allow email fallback to vendor@redwood-billing.com with the VendorToken subject if portal access is delayed? My note above proposes we provide a provisioning token once onboarding form is complete.
2) Do we need a hard PO-stamp requirement for partner invoices to auto-pay, or is PO_Number column sufficient if it matches?

My recommendation: allow fallback for 30 days from activation, require PO_Number column; procurement to mark invoices as auto-pay only when PO matches and vendor has completed onboarding.

—Tessa
